g.aria-label: Keep the period, proportions, and spacing intact.
Generous margins. Thin rules. Square panels. Minimal decoration.
Use a circle as an editorial focal point or diagram node.
Keep it clear of text and logo clear space.
Never detach or move the period inside the wordmark.
Typography specimens, not homepage messaging. Tight Shift remains archived.
Full rules, source files, and actual-size proofs / identity/index.html
